dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Hey, if it isn't my old customer!

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: The truth is I was a traveling merchant in the desert before making enough money to start this establishment.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Life was rough in the desert. The Eremites actually looked after me there, and that's why I helped those outlaws.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: But now I have nothing to do with them. You'll forgive me, right?
